responsibility: CLI argument parsing, run setup, output-root validation, high-level orchestration, summary/report call sequence
inputs: CLI args, repo root, selected rows, module results
outputs: config.yaml, selected_cases.csv, delegated output files, summary.json, report.md
must_not_own: SQL parsing details, manifest/schema parsing details, adapter subprocess internals, result comparison logic, official metrics
upstream_dependencies: argparse, case_selection.py, future resolver, future adapter_runner.py, future user_ledger.py
notes: Do not turn into monolithic metrics runner

responsibility: Select Common-core case-engine rows from case-set metadata
inputs: case_set, pool, engine, case_list, smoke flag, case_sets/common_core_v0 CSVs
must_not_own: Manifest parsing, checker logic, membership by directory scanning
risks: Selection behavior could drift if resolver takes over membership

responsibility: Resolve package assets for a selected case-engine row
inputs: SelectedCaseEngineRow, repo root, manifest.yaml, case package files
must_not_own: Adapter invocation, DB execution, checker execution, metrics
upstream_dependencies: case_selection.py selected rows, case package manifest, filesystem
downstream_consumers: user_run.py, adapter_runner.py, postgres_execution.py, local_result_checker.py, future tag_slices.py
risks: Incorrect fallback to deleted compatibility paths
notes: Resolver must fail closed when required files are absent

responsibility: Invoke user adapter and capture candidate SQL
inputs: ResolvedCasePackage, SelectedCaseEngineRow, adapter command, workspace path, timeout
must_not_own: SQL correctness, DB execution, checker, metrics
risks: Changing shell/cwd/capture semantics could break users
notes: Preserve shell=False, cwd repo root, candidate.sql before stdout

responsibility: Assemble typed rows, apply local failure bucket priority, write ledger.csv and failures.csv
inputs: selection rows, resolver result, adapter result, execution result, checker result, future preflight/timing result
must_not_own: DB execution, checker execution, official metrics, paper tables
downstream_consumers: user_run.py, future quality report, future tag slices
risks: Failure bucket priority could be treated as metric policy
notes: Keep explicit local-only boundary flags false/true as appropriate

responsibility: Define local user-run field names and status constants
inputs: Schema design decisions, U1 field audit
risks: Uncontrolled schema changes could break CSV compatibility
notes: Future additions should be additive where possible

responsibility: Optional PostgreSQL local diagnostic execution with external-schema resolution
inputs: Selected row, candidate SQL path, run/workspace info, PostgreSQL config
must_not_own: Speedup, official metrics, paper rendering, candidate generation
upstream_dependencies: case package manifest schema.external_profile, external schema metadata
downstream_consumers: user_run.py now, future engine_execution.py and user_ledger.py
risks: Resolver duplication with PostgreSQL schema resolution
notes: Minimal split can leave current external-schema resolver here until engine router phase

responsibility: Compare local source/candidate JSONL artifacts using case-local checker configs
inputs: case_dir, result paths, checker output dir
must_not_own: SQL execution, parsing, timing, official semantic verifier claims
risks: Checker status may be overread as official equivalence

responsibility: Static candidate readiness checks before DB execution
inputs: candidate SQL path, source SQL path, resolver metadata
downstream_consumers: user_ledger.py, future quality report, future tag slices
risks: Adding preflight during U2 would expand scope
notes: Out of scope for U2 minimal split

responsibility: Route execution by engine to PostgreSQL/MySQL/Spark implementations
inputs: engine, resolved package, candidate SQL, run settings
risks: Premature router could destabilize PostgreSQL path

responsibility: Create denominator-aware local diagnostic quality summaries
risks: Quality terms could be confused with official metrics

responsibility: Join rows with manifest/taxonomy tags for diagnostic slices
must_not_own: Tag scores, rankings, SQL-text tag inference, leaderboard
risks: Inferring tags from SQL text would be unstable

outputs: raw timing artifacts and timing status fields
must_not_own: GM_Speedup, Speedup Ratio Percentiles, official metrics
risks: Timing could be mistaken for official speedup
